text:
### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, every trace contained all of A25, A26, A27, A28, A31, A36, A37 and A42. In the later window, A27 appears in about 54 in 100 traces and A36, A37 and A42 in about 47–48 in 100, while A25, A26, A28 and A31 still appear in essentially all traces. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, POS001, POS002, POS004, POS005]

- Earlier behaviour: A25 was followed by one of A36, A37, A42 (roughly 34, 32 and 30 in 100 of A25's outgoing transitions); the three ran in mixed order (each pair close to 50/50 in both directions), each was followed by A28 (about 25–35 in 100 of their outgoing transitions), A26 led to A27 in about 99 in 100 transitions, and A25 reached A28 typically 4–5 steps later. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, REL014, REL020, REL021, REL022, LAG001]

- In the later window, A25 leads directly to A28 in about 97 in 100 of its outgoing transitions, and the A25-to-A28 distance is 1 step in about 97 in 100 cases. A26 now routes about 52 in 100 of its outgoing transitions to A27 and about 44 in 100 to A36/A37/A42. The block members now lead to A31 (about 26–35 in 100 of their outgoing transitions) instead of to A28, which they still name in only about 1 in 100. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, LAG001]

- A27 and each of A36, A37, A42 have become mutually exclusive: before, A27 co-occurred with each of them in every trace, always after them (97–98 in 100); in the later window they co-occur in at most about 1 in 100 traces, with A27 alone in about 53 in 100 and the block member alone in about 47 in 100. [REL011, REL012, REL013]

- The block still acts as a group in the later window: A36, A37 and A42 co-occur in about 47 in 100 traces, are jointly absent in about 52–53 in 100, and remain unordered among themselves; A26 still precedes both A27 and the block, A28 still precedes A27, and both A27 and the block still precede A31. [REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022]

- Positions shifted accordingly: A36, A37 and A42 now occur later in the trace (mean relative position about 0.40 to about 0.57), while A28 and A26 occur earlier (about 0.46 to 0.39 and 0.60 to 0.54). [POS002, POS004, POS006, POS007, POS008]

- Several lag items concerning A25 or A28 together with block members rest on only 1–2 after-window observations; they indicate these pairs are no longer within five steps of each other. [LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG006, LAG007, LAG009]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the segment around A25–A31 was restructured so that the three-activity block A36/A37/A42 and the single activity A27 became mutually exclusive alternatives. Before, every case ran A25, then the block A36/A37/A42 in mixed order, then A28, A26, A27 and A31. In the later window, A25 connects directly to A28, and after A26 a case takes either A27 alone (about 53 in 100 cases) or the three-activity block (about 47 in 100), with A31 following either branch; the block effectively moved from before A28/A26 to after A26. This is shown directly by the successor changes at A25 and A26, by the relational switch from "always both, block first" to "either A27 or the block", and by the matching participation drops; with 48 qualifying items against roughly 0.7 expected if nothing had changed, sampling variation cannot explain the evidence as a whole. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, REL005, REL006, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, LAG001, LAG005]

Limitations: many items describe the same underlying restructuring and are not independent confirmations, and a few lag items rest on only 1–2 after-window observations. A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is a change in the case mix between the windows (for example, case types that follow different routes) rather than a modification of one and the same process. [LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG006, LAG007, LAG009]

Other differences: A25's mean relative position moved slightly later (about 0.34 to 0.37) and A31's slightly earlier (about 0.65 to 0.63); both are small and consistent with the re-routing above rather than separate changes. [POS001, POS005]
